narrator.role: Narrator — sets scene, warm energetic, community-day vibe

kiro.role: Kiro — friendly AI assistant, sharp and a little witty

emcee.role: Community Day emcee — cheerful, keeps the day moving

segments.text: Doors open. AWS Community Day. You badge in, coffee in hand, and immediately realize the schedule is a wall of parallel tracks and demo booths.
Two rooms of talks. A demo alley. A closing quiz at five PM with swag on the line. You can't catch it all solo.
Hi. I'm Kiro. Your assistant for the day. I plan your agenda, I walk the floor with you, and I get you to the buzzer with a real answer. Come find me on the main floor.
Welcome, everyone. Doors open, tracks start in fifteen. Closing quiz at five sharp. Swag for those who answer before the buzzer. Have a great day, folks.
Ten minutes on the clock. Three rooms. Decode your badge, walk the floor with Kiro, and beat the buzzer.
Five minutes remaining. Halfway through Community Day.
How's the floor? If you've got Session Intel and your Personalized Agenda in hand, you're ready. Auditorium's next — closing quiz in a few. I'll narrate the questions.
Five to closing. If you're still on the floor, start heading toward the auditorium — you don't want to miss the buzzer.
The buzzer freezes with seconds to spare. Your name lights up the big screen. The swag table calls you over.
This morning you walked in solo to a schedule you couldn't possibly catch.
Kiro planned your day — a specific action, a specific subject, the tracks you actually cared about, in the format you'd actually follow.
Kiro walked the fogged floor with you — steered you to the sessions that mattered and around the queue that would have eaten your lunch.
And Kiro got you to the buzzer — the numbers came from your own day, and the winning answer was the name of your assistant.
Keynote to closing quiz, you didn't miss a thing. That's Kiro — your assistant, all day.
Told you we'd catch it all. Planned, walked, won. Same time next Community Day — I'll be here.
Big round for our grand-prize winner. Grab your swag, gather up for the group photo, and thanks for coming out.
Five PM. The buzzer sounds. Your final answer never made it in.
You didn't fail — you just didn't finish. The three moves are still true: plan your day, walk the floor with your assistant, get to the buzzer with the real numbers.
Hey. First Community Day is always a lot. Next year we'll hit the buzzer at four fifty-nine. Deal?
Swag table's still open for a few. Grab a shirt on your way out, and see you next year.
The cloud is patient. Mostly. Try again — the auditorium is waiting.
